These malformed metadata values can therefore produce verified_candidate decisions. Preserve the completed type-safety improvement and add targeted regression coverage without replacing existing tests or repeating completed work.: Explicit nonboolean ambiguity metadata must return human_review with reason ambiguous_question, regardless of truthiness. Explicit False and an absent ambiguity key must retain existing candidate behavior. True must continue requiring review. Existing contact-type compatibility, unknown-question, unsupported-control, and unverified-fact safeguards must remain unchanged. Modify only the two approved paths, append rather than replace autonomous regressions, preserve the immutable Git blob identity, and independently pass all ten mandatory test cases before committing. No network, private data, submissions, deployment, publication, or automatic merge.
